Wheel.title: Wheel
Wheel.description: Represents a custom or preset spin wheel configuration

userId.description: The UID of the user who owns this wheel

title.description: The display title of the wheel

description.description: Optional description or context for the wheel

themePalette.description: Color palette theme name (e.g. RAINBOW, NEON, PASTEL, SUNSET, OCEAN, CANDY)

spinDurationSeconds.description: Duration in seconds for the wheel deceleration animation

autoRemoveWinner.description: Whether to auto-disable the winning item after selection

soundEnabled.description: Whether wheel tick audio is enabled

hapticsEnabled.description: Whether tactile vibration ticks are enabled

isPreset.description: Whether this wheel is a built-in template

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the wheel was created

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the wheel was last modified

WheelItem.title: WheelItem
WheelItem.description: Represents an individual slice/name option on a spin wheel

isEnabled.description: Whether the slice is currently active on the wheel

orderIndex.description: Position order in the slice list

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when item was added

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when item was last modified

SpinHistory.title: SpinHistory
SpinHistory.description: Record of a completed wheel spin and winning choice

userId.description: UID of the user who performed the spin

timestamp.description: Server timestamp when the spin completed

/users/{userId}/wheels/{wheelId}.description: User custom and saved spin wheels

/users/{userId}/wheels/{wheelId}/items/{.description: Options and names on the wheel
